items.note: Itoh fills the second rotation spot, and the price was set before he signed. Still a pass at 25-1: the rotation behind Rogers and Itoh is Cabrera, Steele and Assad. A catcher upgrade by Tuesday would make it closer.
The champs priced like a juggernaut. Repeating is hard and this price leaves nothing on the table.
Just behind the Cubs on the board. The market sees Pittsburgh as a real NL Central threat.
Lost Rogers, paid $125M for Peralta. That's a sideways move priced at 50-1.

futures.note: No new 2027 prices since Wednesday; DraftKings still has the Cubs at +2500, tied with the Padres, Guardians and Braves (CBS Sports, Nov. 25). Itoh agreed Friday night, after that board. Expect a small move, not a big one: he's a mid-rotation arm.

pass: No Cubs game until the spring opener on Feb. 19. No daily pick in the offseason.
